message.content: {"q1_human_microarray_expression_profiling":{"answer":"No","evidence":"Study type: transcription profiling by array; Description: \"After DNA extraction, 16S rRNA genes were PCR amplified and DNA-DNA hybridization was performed using a microarray for over 300 bacterial species or groups.\" Assay: Technology: Array assay; Assay by Molecule: RNA assay.","justification":"The array was used to detect bacterial 16S rRNA / species (microbial community profiling), not human gene expression microarray profiling."},"q2_target_disease":{"answer":"No","evidence":"Samples / Source Characteristics: Disease: periodontitis; Description: study analyzes gingival crevicular fluid of periodontitis patients; Title and abstract focus on subgingival microbiota and periodontal disease.","justification":"The study concerns periodontitis (oral disease), not amyotrophic lateral sclerosis or frontotemporal dementia."},"q3_human_cns_tissue":{"answer":"No","evidence":"Description: \"Analysis of gingival crevicular fluid (GCF) samples... Subgingival paper point (PP) samples from the same sites...\" Source characteristics list no organism part; disease listed as periodontitis.","justification":"Samples are oral (gingival crevicular fluid / subgingival plaque), not human brain or CNS tissue."},"q4_non_clinical":{"answer":"No","evidence":"Description: samples analyzed from \"17 subjects with periodontal disease\"; Sample attributes show disease state: periodontitis.","justification":"This uses patient clinical samples (oral fluids/plaques), not patient-derived in vitro cell lines or experimental disease models."},"q5_case_control_design":{"answer":"No","evidence":"Experimental Designs: Not found; Description and sample summary report 17 subjects with periodontal disease and comparison between GCF and PP samples from same sites; no healthy control group indicated.","justification":"Study compares sample types within periodontitis patients (GCF vs plaque) rather than a case vs healthy-control study design relevant to ALS/FTD case–control comparisons."},"q6_irrelevant_brain_region":{"answer":"Yes","evidence":"Description: sampling from gingival crevicular fluid and subgingival plaque (oral cavity); Organism part: not brain/CNS.","justification":"Tissue sampled is oral (gingiva/subgingival), which is not a CNS region affected by ALS-FTD."},"q7_incompatible_technology":{"answer":"Yes","evidence":"Technology: Array assay; Description: DNA-DNA hybridization microarray targeting >300 bacterial species (16S rRNA PCR products). Assay by Molecule: RNA assay (16S rRNA-based detection).","justification":"Although an array was used, it targets microbial 16S rRNA / species presence, not human transcriptome expression profiling. Thus it is not compatible with the human CNS gene-expression microarray data required."},"q8_inclusion_justification":{"justification":"Exclude: dataset profiles microbial species in gingival crevicular fluid from periodontitis patients (oral samples), not human CNS tissue; disease is periodontitis, not ALS-FTD; study is not a case/control ALS-FTD design; the array targets bacterial 16S profiles rather than human gene expression."},"q9_include_dataset":{"answer":"No"}}

{"q1_human_microarray_expression_profiling":{"answer":"Yes","evidence":"Study type: transcription profiling by array; Assays and Data: Technology: Array assay; Assay by Molecule: RNA assay; Organism listed as Homo sapiens.","justification":"The dataset used mRNA microarrays (array-based transcription profiling) on human-derived samples (xenografted human tumor tissue/cells)."},"q2_target_disease":{"answer":"No","evidence":"Title and Description describe gastric carcinoma (human gastric cancer, Krukenberg tumor) and metastasis to ovary; no mention of ALS, FTD, motor neuron disease, or related terms.","justification":"The study focuses on gastric cancer metastasis, not amyotrophic lateral sclerosis or frontotemporal dementia."},"q3_human_cns_tissue":{"answer":"No","evidence":"Experimental Factors / Source Characteristics: Organism part values include xenografted tumor metastasized to ovaries and xenografted tumor formed in stomach; no brain/CNS tissues listed.","justification":"All samples are from gastric/ovarian xenografted tumors (peripheral tissues), not human brain or CNS regions."},"q4_non_clinical":{"answer":"Yes","evidence":"Description: human SNU-16 gastric carcinoma cells were orthotopically injected into BALB/c nude mice to generate xenografted tumors; cells were dissociated, cultured, and re‑injected — an in vivo mouse model using human cell line.","justification":"This is an experimental xenograft disease model (human cell line in mice) rather than primary patient CNS tissue; therefore it meets the exclusion for patient-derived in vitro/cellular disease models."},"q5_case_control_design":{"answer":"No","evidence":"Experimental Designs: Not found; Experimental Factors only list organism part; Sample annotations do not indicate case vs control groups or clinical/control status.","justification":"No case/control study design is provided (no control/healthy comparator group described)."},"q6_irrelevant_brain_region":{"answer":"Yes","evidence":"Source characteristics list stomach and ovary xenografted tumors; no brain regions sampled.","justification":"The sampled tissues are peripheral (stomach/ovary xenografts) and not CNS regions affected by ALS‑FTD, so the dataset does not sample relevant brain regions."},"q7_incompatible_technology":{"answer":"No","evidence":"Study type: transcription profiling by array; Technology: Array assay; Assay by Molecule: RNA assay.","justification":"The technology is microarray-based expression profiling, which is compatible with inclusion (but other exclusion criteria apply)."},"q8_inclusion_justification":{"justification":"Exclude. Although this is a human microarray expression dataset, it does not pertain to ALS‑FTD, does not include human CNS tissue, and is an experimental xenograft disease model (human cell line in mice). The study also lacks a case/control design. These factors violate multiple inclusion/exclusion criteria."},"q9_include_dataset":{"answer":"No"}}

{"q1_human_microarray_expression_profiling":{"answer":"Yes","evidence":"Study type: transcription profiling by array; Technology: Array assay; Assay by Molecule: RNA assay; Organism: Homo sapiens.","justification":"The study uses array-based transcription profiling of human (Homo sapiens) RNA samples, i.e., human microarray expression profiling."},"q2_target_disease":{"answer":"Yes","evidence":"Sample annotations list Disease/DISEASESTATE: Frontotemporal lobar degeneration (FTLD) / Frontotemporal lobar degeneration, clinical history includes sporadic FTLD-TDP, familial FTLD with MAPT/PGRN mutations.","justification":"FTLD (frontotemporal lobar degeneration) is the pathological/clinical substrate of frontotemporal dementia (FTD), so the dataset pertains to the FTD side of the ALS-FTD spectrum (though no ALS cases are present)."},"q3_human_cns_tissue":{"answer":"Yes","evidence":"Organism part: middle temporal gyrus; Organism: Homo sapiens.","justification":"Samples are from human brain tissue (middle temporal gyrus), a CNS region."},"q4_non_clinical":{"answer":"No","evidence":"Cell type/line: Not found; Sample source: middle temporal gyrus brain tissue; Clinicalhistory entries refer to patient diagnoses and mutations.","justification":"Samples are post-mortem human brain tissue from diagnosed individuals, not patient-derived in vitro cell lines or disease models."},"q5_case_control_design":{"answer":"Yes","evidence":"Experimental Factors: DISEASESTATE with levels normal, Frontotemporal lobar degeneration, Alzheimer's disease; Experimental Designs include disease_state_design and clinical_history_design.","justification":"The design includes diseased groups (FTLD, AD) and cognitively normal controls, constituting a case-control comparison."},"q6_irrelevant_brain_region":{"answer":"No","evidence":"Organism part: middle temporal gyrus; Clinical history: FTLD cases (FTLD-TDP, MAPT, PGRN)","justification":"FTLD/FTD affects frontal and temporal lobes; the middle temporal gyrus (temporal cortex) is a region relevant to FTD-related neurodegeneration, so it is not an irrelevant region."},"q7_incompatible_technology":{"answer":"No","evidence":"Study type: transcription profiling by array; Technology: Array assay; Assay by Molecule: RNA assay.","justification":"The dataset uses microarray (array) technology for RNA expression profiling, which is compatible with inclusion (not RNA-seq or proteomics)."},"q8_inclusion_justification":{"justification":"The dataset meets the key inclusion criteria: human microarray expression profiling of CNS tissue (middle temporal gyrus), includes FTD-related cases (FTLD) with cognitively normal controls (case/control design), and uses compatible array technology. It does not use in vitro models. Note: no ALS cases are present, but the dataset is directly relevant to the FTD component of the ALS-FTD spectrum."},"q9_include_dataset":{"answer":"Yes"}}

{"q1_human_microarray_expression_profiling":{"answer":"Yes","evidence":"Study type: transcription profiling by array; Technology: Array assay; Assay by Molecule: RNA assay; Organism: Homo sapiens.","justification":"Dataset is genome-wide expression profiling performed on human RNA using array technology (microarray transcription profiling)."},"q2_target_disease":{"answer":"Yes","evidence":"Description: '...patients with four neurodegenerative disorders (5 AD, 5 PSP, 5 PiD and 5 FTD patients) and 5 control subjects.' Samples list includes Disease: Alzheimer's disease.","justification":"Alzheimer's disease (AD) is explicitly included as one of the studied disease groups (5 AD patients)."},"q3_human_cns_tissue":{"answer":"Yes","evidence":"Description: 'snap frozen post-mortem tissue from the medial temporal lobe'; Samples: Organism part: medial temporal lobe.","justification":"Samples are human post-mortem CNS tissue from the medial temporal lobe, a brain region relevant to AD."},"q4_non_clinical":{"answer":"No","evidence":"Samples: Cell type/line: Not found; Description refers to snap-frozen post-mortem tissue, not cell lines or models.","justification":"Material is patient post-mortem brain tissue rather than patient-derived in vitro cell lines or experimental disease models. No cell lines reported. "},"q5_case_control_design":{"answer":"Yes","evidence":"Description: 5 AD and 5 control subjects; Experimental Designs: disease_state_design; Experimental Factors: disease.","justification":"The study includes disease and control groups (case/control comparisons between AD and controls are present)."},"q6_irrelevant_brain_region":{"answer":"No","evidence":"Samples: Organism part: medial temporal lobe; Description: medial temporal lobe sampling.","justification":"Medial temporal lobe is a brain region significantly affected in AD (relevant), so not an excluded region like cerebellum. "},"q7_intermediate_phenotype":{"answer":"No","evidence":"Samples: Disease staging lists include 'braak stage 6' as well as other stages (0–2, etc.).","justification":"The dataset contains samples with Braak stage 6 (neocortical, V/VI), so it is not limited to intermediate phenotypes only. AD cases include late-stage pathology. "},"q8_familial_alzheimer_disease":{"answer":"No","evidence":"Clinical/familial: matched for ApoE-epsilon and MAPT haplotype; no indication of familial AD in clinical/familial fields.","justification":"No evidence that cases are familial AD; matching on common risk haplotypes suggests sporadic cases. Familial AD not indicated. "},"q9_incompatible_technology":{"answer":"No","evidence":"Study type: transcription profiling by array; Technology: Array assay; Assay by Molecule: RNA assay.","justification":"Data were generated using microarray (array) technology, not RNA-seq or proteomics, so technology is compatible. "},"q10_inclusion_justification":{"justification":"The dataset meets inclusion criteria: human microarray expression profiling of post-mortem CNS tissue (medial temporal lobe), includes AD cases and controls, contains late-stage AD samples (Braak stage 6), is not based on cell lines or models, and uses compatible array technology. No indication of familial AD-only cases. Therefore it is suitable for inclusion."},"q11_include_dataset":{"answer":"Yes"}}

{"q1_human_microarray_expression_profiling":{"answer":"Yes","evidence":"Study type: transcription profiling by array; Technology: Array assay; Assay by Molecule: RNA assay; Title: Gene expression profiles ...","justification":"Dataset uses array-based transcription profiling of human RNA (microarray-style array assay), matching the human microarray expression profiling criterion."},"q2_target_disease":{"answer":"No","evidence":"Experimental Factors > Disease: normal, Sporadic Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis; Organism part: v4 cortex; Title specifies motor cortex.","justification":"Samples are human brain (motor cortex) tissue, so human CNS tissue is involved."},"q4_non_clinical":{"answer":"No","evidence":"Cell type/line: Not found; Title and sample metadata indicate patient motor cortex tissue (Control and Sporadic ALS patients).","justification":"Samples are patient brain tissue, not patient-derived in vitro cell lines or disease models."},"q5_case_control_design":{"answer":"Yes","evidence":"Experimental Designs: case control design; Title focuses on motor cortex.","justification":"Motor cortex is the primary tissue affected in ALS and is not a canonical AD-affected region (study is disease-focused on motor cortex), so the sampled region is not appropriate for AD neurodegeneration analysis."},"q7_intermediate_phenotype":{"answer":"No","evidence":"Disease indicated is Sporadic ALS; Disease state/staging: Not found; no Braak staging provided.","justification":"The dataset does not concern AD phenotypes or Braak staging; it is not an AD intermediate-phenotype dataset."},"q8_familial_alzheimer_disease":{"answer":"No","evidence":"Disease: Sporadic Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis; Clinical/familial metadata refer to family history of various conditions but not familial AD cases.","justification":"Dataset does not consist of familial AD cases (it is ALS and labeled sporadic)." },"q9_incompatible_technology":{"answer":"No","evidence":"Study type: transcription profiling by array; Technology: Array assay; Assay by Molecule: RNA assay.","justification":"The assay is array-based (microarray), which is compatible with inclusion requirements."},"q10_inclusion_justification":{"justification":"Exclude: Although this is a human microarray case/control study on brain tissue, the disease is sporadic ALS (not Alzheimer's) and the tissue is motor cortex targeted to ALS. It does not meet the requirement that the dataset pertains to Alzheimer's disease and AD-relevant brain regions."},"q11_include_dataset":{"answer":"No"}}
